leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize an Axios instance with a base URL for API requests
Configure an Axios request interceptor to attach authorization tokens to outgoing requests
Implement an Axios response interceptor to detect expired token errors (401)
Construct a token refresh function that calls the refresh endpoint and updates stored tokens
Integrate token refresh logic into the response interceptor to retry failed requests
Control request queuing during token refresh to prevent duplicate refresh calls
Apply the configured Axios instance to Vue components for making authenticated API calls
